Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: Data quality board: per record type, fields that are empty in practice, bad emails and phones, broken links, each with a fix. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 5)
- AC2: Bulk archive with dependency check: archive products or contacts only when nothing open still uses them. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 8)
- AC3: Two-database compare: staging vs production setup differences in plain words (fields, screens, settings, scheduled actions). (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 10)
- AC4: Role x-ray: pick a user and see everything they can do across every app, and why. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 12)
- AC5: Access hygiene: admins who never log in, users with no role, portal users without recent activity. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 13)
- AC6: Numbering check (look only): gaps or duplicates in document sequences, explained without changing accounting. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 15)
- AC7: Translation coverage: how complete each installed language is for your custom labels and fields. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 17)
- AC8: Automation catalogue: every automation and server action in plain words with "last fired" and "fires on". (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 18)
- AC9: Unused apps finder: installed apps with no records for 90 days, with what uninstalling would remove (look only). (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 19)
- AC10: Custom field clean-up: fields made in this database that are never filled, with their dependency map. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 20)
- AC11: Storage forecast: file growth trend from real dates, and when the current pace reaches a size you set. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 21)
- AC12: Import aftercare: records created by recent imports that look duplicated or incomplete. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 22)
- AC13: Record time-travel: a readable timeline of one record's tracked changes, from Odoo's own tracking. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 24)
- AC14: Day-1 review: a checklist for a fresh database (company details, country package, users, mail server, backups). (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 29)
- AC15: Hot-spot heatmap: which record types get bulk-changed most, to spot processes worth automating. (source: CONFIG_SUITE_SPEC idea 33)
